cohort: 57 neonates born at 34 weeks of gestation or more with perinatal asphyxia.
finding: ECG changes were observed in 77.1% of asphyxiated neonates, and 45.6% had echocardiographic changes, with mitral regurgitation and global hypokinesia being associated with the worst outcome.
mod_finding: 40.4% of neonates were born via cesarean section, and 5.3% were delivered via assisted vaginal delivery.
